review_scope: Direct inspection of all 18 receipt-listed native PNGs: four representative selected identities in overview and enlarged view at 1280x720 and 960x540, plus two explicitly synthetic missing-library fallback views.
observations: At 1280x720 the detailed artwork, selected identity, status, stat table and navigation fit without observed overlap.
The 960x540 views preserve the arrangement and identity correspondence, but small secondary text is coarse and needs human readability review.
The two synthetic fallback captures visibly substitute sprite portraits and explain unavailable detailed art while retaining stats, status and navigation.
Current equipped identity is visibly Oh Tipi throughout; inspecting other characters is visibly distinguished from attuned state. Screenshots alone do not prove state mutation prevention.

review_limits: This is an assistant review of saved screenshots, not human artwork, readability, accessibility or fun acceptance.
Only four identities have detailed production Gallery views here; viewing all roster card pages does not constitute all-30 detailed-portrait acceptance.
Only facing zero is shown in these saved frames; receipt asset checks for eight headings were not independently visually exercised by this reviewer.
No engine was run and no physical keyboard, mouse, gamepad, focus, resize transition or portrait-toggle interaction was performed.
No attunement, network, simulation, performance, package/distribution or release acceptance is established.
Synthetic fallback images do not prove real missing/corrupt import recovery or diagnostic behavior.
Observed stat text was compared across screenshots, not independently validated against gameplay authority.
Hashes and dimensions establish exact reviewed bytes and native sizes, not correctness or quality.
